entities.summary: Sainte-Marie des Batignolles is a Roman Catholic church, modelled after a classical temple, located in the Batignolles quarter of the 17th arrondissement of Paris. While the exterior of the church is very plain, the interior features lavish 19th century sculptures, carving, stained glass and decoration.
